intro: The Bloodvenom River is a foul waterway cutting through central Felwood, saturated with the demonic corruption that blighted the ancient forest. Its putrid waters seep downstream across the mountains into Darkshore, transforming into the tainted Wildbend River.

p: Running through the corrupted heart of Felwood, the Bloodvenom River serves as an open conduit of the land's spiritual and physical decay. Its banks are thick with vile oozes, mutated beasts, and foul run-off left in the wake of the Burning Legion's invasion. The corruption within the channel is potent enough to taint lands far beyond Felwood itself, flowing westward down into the coastal forests of Darkshore as the Wildbend River.
